findings.issue: PokemonCard imports apiUrl from lib/api.js, which reads process.env.API_BASE_URL; the component is implicitly server-only but neither file says so, so moving it into a client component yields 'undefined/media/...' sprite URLs
findings.suggestion: Pass the sprite URL in as a prop from the server pages (or add a server-only guard/comment and move URL building into a helper in lib/api.js with an explicit server-only note)

findings.issue: The fetch-resource + generateMetadata + notFound scaffolding is hand-rolled four times (also abilities:15-21, types:17-25, pokemon:26-33); a new resource type copies it rather than reusing it
findings.suggestion: Extract a small helper, e.g. resource(name, path) returning { record, title } and a shared generateMetadata factory

findings.issue: The '<count> Pokémon' + <ul className="cards"> block is copy-pasted across three pages, so any change to card lists (sorting, count wording, empty state) is a 3-file edit
findings.suggestion: Extract a PokemonCardList component ({ pokemon, showTypes }) used by move, ability and type pages

findings.issue: Home-page card ordering lives here while the other three lists are ordered in lib/data.js:106, so 'sort cards by X' is a two-site change that can drift
findings.suggestion: Have the home list consume the same ordering helper from lib/data.js (or document the split: pagination-driven ordering is home-only)

findings.issue: The type-label fallback 'typeLabels.get(x) ?? humanize(x)' is repeated in four places
findings.suggestion: Add a typeLabel(name) helper in lib/data.js that closes over getTypeLabels()

findings.issue: Missing-value dash is a local MISSING const in components/MovesSection.jsx:10 but raw '—' literals here, so restyling/handling of missing values needs edits in both
findings.suggestion: Import a shared MISSING (or a formatValue helper) from lib/format.js in both files

findings.issue: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' is the pre-16.4 caching idiom, repeated in all five pages; Next 16.4's guidance moves to Cache Components ('use cache' + uncached fetches), which becomes the default in Next 17
findings.suggestion: Fine for now given the spec's always-fresh-data requirement; plan a migration to Cache Components before the Next 17 upgrade rather than spreading more segment-config flags

findings.issue: The component renders its own <li>, so it silently requires a <ul className="cards"> parent and mixes list-structure responsibility into a 'Card' component
findings.suggestion: Render just the <Link> and let a thin CardList wrapper own list markup, or document the contract in the component's doc comment

summary: A small, well-layered App Router codebase where the load-bearing seams (PokemonCard, pokemonRefsToSpecies, api.js) are exactly where you'd want them, so removal and cross-cutting bug fixes are cheap. The recurring weakness is copy-pasted page scaffolding — four fetch/metadata boilerplates and three identical card-list blocks — which makes the next resource type and list-behaviour changes duplication-driven rather than reuse-driven. No dead code, no flag-parameter creep, and the two client components are cleanly fed serializable props. Overall an easy codebase to change, one small refactor away from very easy.
